_about: Public-domain Thomas Raffles (1788-1863), Congregational minister of Great George Street Chapel, Liverpool, for the Word Hoard: Memoirs of the Life and Ministry of the Rev. Thomas Spencer (1813) and a lecture on Purgatory and Prayers for the Dead. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 59 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

raffles-thomas-spencer: Memoirs of the life and ministry of the late Rev. Thomas Spencer, of Liverpool : with an appendix, containing a selection from his papers, &c (Boston ; Published by C. Williams, 1813)
raffles-purgatory: Purgatory and prayers for the dead : a lecture delivered in Grinshaw-Street and Lune-Street chapels, Preston, March 22nd and 29th, 1821 (Liverpool : Thomas Taylor, 1821)

_excluded.raffles-other: Sir Thomas Stamford Raffles, his cousin, and the memoir of Thomas Raffles by his son
